caption: for the girlies caught in the scroll cycle 🌀 my digital minimalism journey has been a longgg one. I’ve simply tried every product, hack, anything in the book to reduce my screen time. Some work wonders for me (@getclearspace app) and others just didn’t fit my lifestyle quite right (@thelightphone ) My relationship with my phone and social media has changed drastically over the last couple of years, but I still could feel this tiny pull toward my phone, even when I didn’t want to be on it. @getbrick felt too good to be true, so I didn’t let myself get excited about it. But wow wow wow this thing has already changed my relationship with tech dramatically 😩 I’m sure there are tons of benefits to come, but what I’m really enjoying right now is deep, focused, uninterrupted work. I find admin so monotonous so my phone creeps in and gets me off task. With the brick, I’m able to lock ALL distracting apps to get to a deep level of focus. And wow, it’s made all the difference :’) I have 3 modes on my brick for now and here are the apps I have blocked for each: •creative 🌞 apps blocked: email, ig, tiktok allowed: Pinterest (one of my biggest sources of inspiration) Deep work 🌿 blocked: ig, tt, Pinterest, text messages, email, safari •sleep 🌙 blocked: ig, tt, Pinterest, YouTube, safari **not sponsored just obsessed :’) #slowliving #simpliving #saltedgranola #granolagirl #digitaldetox #adhdgirlies #unplugged #cozytok #earthyaesthetic
